bio: Sebastian is a Venezuelan screenwriter working in TV and film in Mexico City. He has a Fine Arts degree in Creative Writing and Film Studies from the University of British Columbia in Vancouver. An Oscars buff since he began organising ballots at his Middle School, he has written for the likes of Gold Derby and Awards Expert. Fun fact about Sebastian: for three years in a row, he came in the top 100 in all of Mexico for predicting the Oscars, winning a year’s worth of free movie tickets each time. Follow him on Letterboxd and Awards Expert: @monkeykong84
name: Sebastian Ochoa
